findings.title: DOMPurify Template Bypass & Armed Event Handlers (GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7 / GHSA-mrv2-3pqr-j5jr)
findings.threat_scenario: In versions of DOMPurify prior to 3.4.17, split template expressions could survive in attached shadow root content in DOM output modes, allowing potential DOM-based XSS when user-supplied content is parsed into templates.
findings.adversarial_validation: Disproven as false positive? No. The dependency tree resolved to 3.4.16, which is explicitly vulnerable according to GitHub Advisory Database (GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7). Confirmed vulnerable.
findings.remediation: Updated package.json to ^3.4.17 and executed npm audit fix, replacing the vulnerable tree with clean 3.4.17.

findings.title: Zod Memory Exhaustion via Oversized Constrained Collections (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5)
findings.threat_scenario: An attacker submitting deeply nested or oversized collections against Zod schemas could cause unbounded memory allocation, leading to process crash / Denial of Service.
findings.adversarial_validation: Verified against installed version 4.6.5. Confirmed vulnerable.
findings.remediation: Updated package.json dependency to zod ^4.6.7, eliminating the memory exhaustion edge case.

findings.title: Vite Launch-Editor & Static Path Traversal Advisories (GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm / GHSA-rq7h-c2jc-7f22)
findings.threat_scenario: Development server vulnerabilities in launch-editor permitted arbitrary command execution via misparsed flags or Windows bypasses, and cross-origin script execution via custom middleware.
findings.adversarial_validation: Direct dependency check confirmed vite 6.2.3 was installed. Confirmed vulnerable.
findings.remediation: Updated package.json to vite ^6.4.5 and updated package-lock.json to patched build.

findings.title: Permissive Content-Security-Policy (CSP) with 'unsafe-eval' in Production Header
findings.threat_scenario: Serving 'unsafe-eval' within the Content-Security-Policy header in production environments reduces defense-in-depth against DOM injection by allowing eval() and Function() string evaluation.
findings.adversarial_validation: Source review confirmed static header string included 'unsafe-eval' unconditionally regardless of NODE_ENV. Confirmed vulnerable.
findings.remediation: Refactored CSP generation in server.ts to dynamically exclude 'unsafe-eval' when process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'.

findings.title: Overly Permissive Suffix Origin Validation in apiSecurityGuard
findings.threat_scenario: Checking originUrl.hostname.endsWith('.run.app') allowed any third-party tenant deploying a web app on Google Cloud Run (*.run.app) to make cross-origin authenticated or rate-limited requests without being blocked by origin validation.
findings.adversarial_validation: Verified logic in server.ts: any attacker with a .run.app service URL would pass the hostname check. Confirmed vulnerable.
findings.remediation: Restricted origin validation to exact same-host matching (originUrl.host === host), localhost/loopback, or current applet host name.

findings.title: Use of window.open in Sandboxed Iframe Context
findings.threat_scenario: Invoking window.open within sandboxed preview iframes triggers browser popup blocker errors, frame breaking, or potential opener window reference leaks.
findings.adversarial_validation: Grep and source trace identified window.open call. Confirmed.
findings.remediation: Replaced window.open with a dynamically created HTMLAnchorElement with rel='noopener noreferrer' and target='_blank'.

findings.title: Client-Side Admin State Dependent Solely on LocalStorage Boolean
findings.threat_scenario: A visitor setting localStorage.setItem('emirhan_admin_logged_in', 'true') would cause the client UI to render the administrative editor modals on reload, confusing local state boundaries.
findings.adversarial_validation: Disproven that this breaches backend data: backend routes require a valid cryptographically issued bearer token from activeAdminSessions. However, client-side UI privilege boundary was bypassed. Confirmed.
findings.remediation: Updated state initialization to require both the localStorage flag AND a valid active session token in sessionStorage (adm_srv_tok).
